slot.empty: {label}: empty. Click to choose an item, or drop one here.
slot.conflict: {item} is in the off hand while {weapon} needs both hands

reject.twoHandedOffHand: {item} needs both hands. Put it in the Main Hand.
reject.offHandBlocked: Both hands are gripping {weapon}. Unequip it first.
reject.notOwner: You don't have permission to change {actor}'s equipment.
reject.foreign: Only items {actor} already carries can be equipped here.

stats.attunementOver: Attuned to more items than allowed

unslotted.title: Also Worn
unslotted.hint: Equipped, but no free slot fits. Free one up, or drag it onto a slot.

portrait.title: Paper Doll Portrait: {actor}
portrait.srcHint: Leave blank to use the character's own portrait. A full-body picture looks best.
portrait.focusHint: Which part of a tall picture to keep in view when it fills the frame.

slotConfig.title: Paper Doll Slots
slotConfig.intro: Choose which slots every character's paper doll shows. Items already worn in a slot you turn off stay equipped and appear under Also Worn.
slotConfig.trinketsHint: Catch-all slots for worn magic items with no better home: ioun stones, figurines, gems.

sheetTab.name: Paper Doll Tab
sheetTab.hint: Add a Paper Doll tab to the D&D 5e character sheet. Reloads the world when changed.

dockButton.name: Docked Paper Doll Button
dockButton.hint: Add a Paper Doll button to character sheet headers that opens the doll in its own window, docked beside the sheet.

dockSide.name: Dock Side
dockSide.hint: Which side of the sheet the docked paper doll prefers. If there isn't room, it uses the other side.

autoDock.name: Open Docked Doll With Sheets
autoDock.hint: Open the docked paper doll automatically whenever you open a character sheet.

strictSlots.name: Strict Slot Matching
strictSlots.hint: When on, worn accessories only fit the slot they belong in: boots on feet, cloaks on the back. When off, any accessory fits any accessory slot. Armor, shields, weapons and rings follow the rules either way.

foreignDrops.name: Dropping New Items
foreignDrops.hint: Who may drop an item the character doesn't already carry (from a compendium or the Items sidebar) onto the paper doll. The item is added to the character's inventory and equipped.

slotLayoutMenu.name: Paper Doll Slots
slotLayoutMenu.label: Configure Slots
slotLayoutMenu.hint: How many ring and trinket slots every character has, and which optional slots are shown.

debugLogging.name: Debug Logging
debugLogging.hint: Print Paper Doll diagnostics to your browser console. Only affects you.

toggleDock.name: Toggle Docked Paper Doll
toggleDock.hint: Open or close the docked paper doll for your selected token's character, or your assigned character.
